WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS baseline_avg
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
), status_avgs AS (
    SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS status_avg
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_status
)
SELECT s.event_status AS status,
       s.status_avg AS average,
       s.status_avg - b.baseline_avg AS average_minus_baseline
FROM status_avgs AS s
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL;
